children: The Shangai Composite Index decreased 31 points or 0.81 percent on Thursday to close at 3811 points.
The decline was led by Guangzhou Automobile (-8.56%), BAIC BluePark (-5.92%) and Greenland Holdings (-4.55%).
On the upside, the strongest performers were Sinopec (3.41%), Petrochina (3.39%) and Sanan Optoelectron (3.22%).

title: The Shangai Composite Index Closes 0.81% Lower
